# MedDevice Simulation Solutions

> Free guide to Medical Device Funding & FDA-Grade Simulation funding for U.S. deep-tech founders (including stealth and pre-incorporation teams), plus how Ansys simulation validates the technology those funders back. Independent Ansys reseller + engineering support. We do not give application advice and guarantee nothing. Reply under 20 min: info@meddevice-simulation-funding.com.
